_README: Machine-readable BLOCKED-RUST-EFFECT residue worklist. Built by the round-54 full programmatic residue re-walk (Agent N3); round-55 (Agent N1) hardened the cron that reads it from a purely-lexical resolver to a structural one; round-56 (Agent N2) added the third `blocked_non_effect` status. Round-63 (Agent N5) ran a full fresh re-walk at HEAD e6f95002 (the round-58..62 BECOMES_TAPPED/Seedship/landfall+counter/Perigee/shockland-fix span) — every genuinely_missing card's REAL parse re-verified via OracleParserCardSource().get_printings() cross-checked against the full live 112-variant Rust Effect:: enum (not just the curated alias list — the round-55 Pulsar lesson applied as a deep verify, not a lexical one); all 7 genuinely_missing / 2 blocked_non_effect / 11 closed entries re-confirmed honest (0 stale, 0 reclassified — a clean re-walk; the cadence machinery held), genuinely_missing entries re-stamped verified_absent_at_commit=e6f95002. The per-entry staleness arms of scripts/check_audit_coverage_staleness.py read THIS file (not the prose audit). LEXICAL arm (round-54): FAILs if any `genuinely_missing` entry's `claimed_missing_effect` (resolved through `aliases`) actually exists as a live Rust Effect:: variant AND a wired _ta_dict_to_python_effect bridge arm. STRUCTURAL arm (round-55, additive, never-blocking — same post-commit-hook contract: the hook ignores the exit code): (a) every `genuinely_missing` entry MUST carry a SHA-shaped `verified_absent_at_commit` (the commit at which a human/agent actually re-verified genuine absence via live-enum + bridge + name-in-wired-arm) — a missing/garbled stamp is `residue_unverified`; (b) the stamp goes stale and yields `residue_needs_reverify` if ANY commit after it touched rust/src/cards.rs or src/mtg_bot/parity/cross_engine.py (the only two files whose changes can ship/bridge an Effect — the exact Pulsar mechanism; git-history absence soft-skips and never false-flags); (c) NON-LEXICAL Pulsar catch: if the card's printed name appears in a LIVE, wired bridge-arm block whose kind resolves to a live Rust Effect:: variant, it is `residue_stale` (hard, NOT ack-suppressible) when that arm's kind also matches a curated alias, else `residue_suspect_needs_reverify` (never-blocking) — suppressible ONLY by an audited per-arm `name_in_arm_ack` (a hand-re-walked 'this wired arm is a DIFFERENT ability of the same card, claimed effect genuinely absent' acknowledgment; per-arm, so a second un-acked arm or a renamed acked arm still surfaces). This closes the gap that let Pulsar Squadron Ace (Effect LookAtTopNRevealOrCounter shipped r28/29, plan-name ChoiceTriggerSpacecraftRevealOrCounter never lexically resolved) pass the r54 re-walk + cron silently. BLOCKED_NON_EFFECT arm (round-56, additive, never-blocking — same hook contract): a third status `blocked_non_effect` for cards where the Effect arm(s) the card needs ARE shipped in Rust but the card's residual blocker is a NON-Effect gate (an unbridged event like BECOMES_TAPPED, a §2-declined cost-mechanic, an unmodeled subsystem, or a token-registration substrate) — it is NOT a BLOCKED-RUST-EFFECT ask. Its invariant is the INVERSE of `genuinely_missing`: the cron asserts every name in the entry's `shipped_variants` list DOES resolve to a live Rust Effect:: variant (so a `blocked_non_effect` entry whose 'shipped' Effect silently regresses to actually-missing is caught — `residue_blocked_non_effect_regressed`), and the entry MUST record its specific `non_effect_blocker` (missing/empty → `residue_blocked_non_effect_underspecified`). It does NOT require bridged=True (that is precisely the point — the card is gated because some non-Effect path is unbridged) and does NOT carry `verified_absent_at_commit` (a genuine-absence stamp is meaningless when the Effects are present; the invariant is shipped-PRESENCE, not absence). The honest 'how far from parity' count is: # genuinely_missing entries = TRUE new-Rust-Effect asks (the load-bearing number); blocked_non_effect entries are NOT in that count (their Effects exist — they need an event-bridge / subsystem, a different lane). `closed` entries are the historical reclassifications kept for the cron's lexical regression check (they MUST resolve to a live+bridged variant; if one stops resolving, the closure prose itself went stale) and do NOT carry the round-55/56 fields. To close a residue card: flip its `status` to `closed`, set `resolved_variant`, drop `verified_absent_at_commit`/`name_in_arm_ack`/`shipped_variants`/`non_effect_blocker`, and sync EOE_PROBE_READINESS_AUDIT.md. See scripts/check_audit_coverage_staleness.py docstring.

_schema.entry: short stable label (matches the audit per-card row)
_schema.claimed_missing_effect: the plan-invented / audit-named Effect the residue row asserts is missing
_schema.aliases: candidate real Rust Effect:: variant names the claimed name could actually be (plan-name -> real-variant resolution; first one present in the live enum wins)
_schema.status: genuinely_missing = audit correctly lists it as BLOCKED-RUST-EFFECT, the claimed Effect arm is genuinely absent from Rust (cron asserts it stays missing — this is the load-bearing 'how far from parity' bucket); blocked_non_effect = the Effect arm(s) the card needs ARE shipped in Rust, the residual blocker is a NON-Effect gate (unbridged event / §2-declined cost-mechanic / unmodeled subsystem / token-registration substrate), it is NOT a new-Rust-Effect ask (cron asserts the named shipped_variants stay live); closed = effect arm shipped + bridged, reclassified out (cron asserts it stays resolvable + bridged)
_schema.verified_absent_at_commit: REQUIRED on every `genuinely_missing` entry (round-55). A SHA-shaped (7-40 hex) git commit at which a human/agent actually re-verified the claimed effect is genuinely absent: no alias resolves to a live Rust Effect:: variant, the printed name is not in any wired bridge-arm that ships a live Effect (or any such arm is name_in_arm_ack-ed as a different ability), and there is no wired bridge arm. CADENCE: refresh the stamp once ANY commit after it has touched rust/src/cards.rs or src/mtg_bot/parity/cross_engine.py — the only two files that can ship/bridge an Effect. The cron emits `residue_unverified` (missing/garbled) or `residue_needs_reverify` (stale by cadence); both never-blocking. Omitted on `blocked_non_effect` and `closed` entries.
_schema.name_in_arm_ack: OPTIONAL on a `genuinely_missing` entry (round-55). A bridge-arm `kind` string (or list of strings) the human re-walked and confirmed is a DIFFERENT ability of the same card — so the card's printed name legitimately appears in that wired arm while the CLAIMED effect is still genuinely absent (e.g. Command Bridge's mana ability in `add_mana_to_pool`; Meltstrider's Resolve's bare-bilateral Fight sibling in `fight_target_creature_with_target_creature`). Suppresses ONLY the `residue_suspect_needs_reverify` row for that EXACT arm kind; never suppresses a hard alias-matched `residue_stale` row, and a second un-acked arm (or a renamed acked arm) still surfaces.
_schema.shipped_variants: REQUIRED on every `blocked_non_effect` entry (round-56). A non-empty list of the live Rust Effect:: variant NAMES the card actually needs (re-derived from the Python parser's real parse, NOT the plan label). The cron asserts EVERY name in this list IS a live Rust Effect:: variant; if any silently regresses to actually-missing the entry is `residue_blocked_non_effect_regressed` (a blocked_non_effect entry that quietly became a genuine-Effect ask again must not pass silently). Omitted on `genuinely_missing` and `closed` entries.
_schema.non_effect_blocker: REQUIRED on every `blocked_non_effect` entry (round-56). A short string naming the specific NON-Effect gate (an unbridged event such as BECOMES_TAPPED, a §2-declined cost-mechanic, an unmodeled subsystem, a token-registration substrate). Missing/empty → `residue_blocked_non_effect_underspecified`. Records WHY the card is still loader-gated even though its Effects are shipped, so the residual is actionable on the correct lane (event-bridge / subsystem, not new-Rust-Effect).
_schema.resolved_variant: for closed entries: the live Rust Effect:: variant the effect actually shipped as
_schema.reclassified_to: for closed entries: the residual non-Effect blocker bucket
